summary: Show related request history in native thread panels

replay.detail: The TUI consumes the generated RequestHistoryPage without joining claims or folding lifecycle state.

schema.detail: Uses the existing generated history read, with explicit 20-item pages and opaque server cursors.

rules.detail: History is explanatory only. Each request keeps its exact source and episode, original payload or unavailable reason, and independently served status and answer. Relation reasons appear only with supplied endpoints.

compatibility.detail: Open thread panels offer Related requests, next page and refresh. Historical source links explicitly open the current source; retained document references stay pinned. Current and saved resolved Inbox items, including typed notices and system-owned sources without a listed agent, use the generated exact-key Start context. Before sending, the TUI displays the exact canonical recipient and original/configured/fallback basis; fallback attribution keeps the retired original separate. Each fresh Start allocates its own target and idempotency key.

manual.detail: No client-side fallback configuration. The daemon selects responsibility and proves retirement; the TUI never infers retirement from offline or missing agents. Existing thread participants and source history are unchanged.

recovery.detail: A definitive stale Start refusal keeps the draft, visibly refreshes the canonical recipient and requires another explicit send; it never silently retargets. Retired or unassigned recipient previews block sending with a visible explanation. Definitively unapplied retired or unassigned Starts remain blocked without an automatic refresh. A missing application proof or prior ambiguous delivery retains the original signed packet and recipient, regardless of a later refusal. Read failures clear history pages; departure, access revocation and member disconnect discard request history.
